quests.title: A Saint's Tour
quests.summary: Prove you know St Helena: meet the wirebird, Jonathan the tortoise and Napoleon's empty tomb, then beat the French Consul.

steps.text: Show a Wirefoot to the Wirebird Warden on Deadwood Plain.
Say hello to Jonathan the tortoise on the lawn at Plantation House.
Pay your respects at Napoleon's tomb in Sane Valley.
Beat the French Consul at Longwood, then report to the Museum Curator.

quests.reward: A Willow Sprig charm, a packet of St Helena Coffee and standing in the Overseas Territories.
